.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))

m <- simple_triplet_matrix(i=c(1,2,1), j=c(1,1,2), v=c(1,2,3), nrow=2, ncol=2)

translation.example:
from slam import simple_triplet_matrix
from slam._arrays import as_matrix
m = simple_triplet_matrix([1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 2], [1, 2, 3], 2, 2)
print(as_matrix(m))
